title: New pro-Brexit campaign took Westminster by surprise, but it is relying on the same old playbook
summary_full: No 10 is confident Burnham can make the case for closer EU ties, with polling showing support from 71% of votersThe launch of a pro-Brexit campaign was one of the few genuine surprises this week in Westminster, even if the arguments were the most familiar playbook.The video launched on X over the weekend, with scenes of riots in France, champagne flowing in Brussels and European politicians saying how desperate they were for Britain’s cash.
